headline: EcoFlow makes the miniature power station even smaller
summary: EcoFlow launches new, smaller River series power stations. Models offer 256Wh and 512Wh capacities. These tiny devices pack significantly more energy.

headline: The real reason your phone is getting more expensive
summary: Next-gen iPhones are expected to come with a higher price tag. Soaring memory costs are driving up smartphone prices. "Chipflation" makes tech components unavoidably expensive.

headline: Bentley’s Torcal EV tries to balance authenticity with fake V8 sounds
summary: Bentley's Torcal EV aims for luxury with electric powertrain benefits. It seeks to balance traditional feel with modern EV performance. The vehicle reportedly includes simulated V8 engine sounds.

headline: Huawei copies Samsung’s privacy display in its latest trifold
summary: Huawei launches its Mate XT 2 trifold phone in China. The new foldable adopts Samsung's inward-folding design. It features a privacy-enhancing display, similar to Samsung's technology.

headline: Walmart Has PS5 Pro Consoles Back in Stock for Labor Day, if You Can Stomach the Price
summary: Walmart has restocked PS5 Pro consoles for Labor Day. Bundles are available, but at a potentially high price. Gamers can find the consoles online now.

headline: Pokémon TCG First Partner Collection Series 3 Is Back in Stock at Amazon
summary: Pokémon TCG First Partner Collection Series 3 is back on Amazon. The latest anniversary set is available at market price. Fans can now purchase the sought-after collection.

headline: Funko Reveals New Doctor Who Pop! Lineup, Featuring First-Ever Figures for River Song and the 15th Doctor
summary: Funko announces a new line of Doctor Who Pop! figures. Includes first-ever figures for River Song and the 15th Doctor (Ncuti Gatwa). Also features the 10th Doctor and a rare Dalek collectible.

headline: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Sells Over 1 Million Day One, Capcom Says It's 'Focusing on Re-Activating IPs That Haven’t Had a New Title Launch Recently'
summary: Capcom's Onimusha: Way of the Sword sold over 1 million copies on launch day. The game is another major hit for the publisher. Capcom plans to revive other dormant IP with new titles.

headline: What we know about anti-migrant protests and organiser Danny Thomas
summary: Danny Thomas organized anti-migrant demonstrations in Dover. He was also present at protests in Portsmouth. The events appear to have been prepared over several weeks.

headline: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over next two years
summary: Jaguar Land Rover plans to cut 4,000 jobs over two years. The cuts are due to Chinese competition and US tariffs. Transitioning to electric vehicles also contributes to the restructuring.

headline: King makes clear Harry and Meghan remain non-working royals
summary: The King has formally stated Harry and Meghan are non-working royals. A letter confirming this was sent to Harry's team and officials. Palace sources confirmed the directive.

headline: Chancellor John Healey refuses to rule out tax hikes in October Budget
summary: Chancellor John Healey wouldn't rule out tax increases in the upcoming Budget. He detailed plans to promote wider UK economic growth. The statement comes ahead of his first official Budget.
